goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: Unfortunately, order ORD-1002 is currently in Processing status and is not eligible for a refund. Orders in Processing must be cancelled instead. Please contact support if you would like to cancel.

story: The customer wants to cancel and refund order ORD-1002 because they changed their mind. The order is still in Processing status and is not eligible for a refund — only cancellation is possible. The agent correctly returns an error and explains the limitation.
starting_sentence: I changed my mind about order ORD-1002. Can I get a refund of $39.99?
